title: spec build fails offline after dbf7e04adf: the deletion gate anchors on authorable-surface.base.json (baseRev 85c6d76ec4) and cannot date #26599 tombstones without the release tag, so every image build breaks
body:
Filing gate: **② a defect the cloud seat's pin round measured.** cloud#3333 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3340, pin `27e4d6564b`): the PR check "Build and exercise EE image" is red. The same Dockerfile layer builds every staging and production image. Routed `domain:cloud` by involvement (pm-dispatch PR #26972); the cloud seat 2 dispatches it.

## 维护者速读

镜像构建里没有网络，spec 的「可写面删除闸」只能退回到仓库里提交的锚点文件 `authorable-surface.base.json`（还停在 9 月 16 日的 `85c6d76ec4`）。#26599 删掉了一批到期的墓碑键，离线时闸门又找不到 `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` 的 tag 来判定它们「已到期」，于是 `@objectstack/spec#build` 失败。cloud 能接受的所有 pin（≥ `bd504f5e1c`）都在 #26599 之后，所以 cloud 的 pin round 和之后每个镜像都卡在这里。修法在 objectstack：把锚点文件用 `gen:schema` 从 git 基线重锚到 #26599 之后，或者让离线路径也能给墓碑定日期。

## What is wrong

- The Docker image's framework layer runs `turbo run build --filter='!./ui/**'`. That build cannot reach `origin/main`, so per `authorable-surface.base.json`'s own description the gate anchors on the committed file. Its `baseRev` is `85c6d76ec42a879f219436eaa58bda06c68298b2`.
- PR #26599 (`dbf7e04adf`, 2026-10-27) deleted aged-out tombstone lines (`ui/ListView:performance`, `ui/FormView:defaultSort`, …). Online, the gate dates them through the release tag `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0`. Offline, it has neither the merge base nor the tag, so it reads them as deletions and fails `@objectstack/spec#build`.
- A full clone with tags passes (the cloud dev's local pin-tree build did), which is why `main`'s own CI is green.

## The change (one of, triage picks)

1. Re-anchor `packages/spec/authorable-surface.base.json` past `dbf7e04adf` through `gen:schema` from a git-resolved baseline, as the file prescribes. Pin it with a test that the anchor is not older than the newest aged-out deletion.
2. Or let the offline path date a tombstone without the tag, for example from a retirement version recorded in-tree, so the next age-out does not repeat this.

Option 1 unblocks now. Option 2 stops the class. Both can land.

## Reader

The cloud lane (seat 2) dispatches it; the write is in `packages/spec`. S–M. Downstream: cloud#3340 waits on it, and so do cloud#3302 and every image built at a pin at or after `dbf7e04adf`.

## Acceptance

- `@objectstack/spec#build` passes in a clone with no network and no tags (`git clone --no-tags --depth 1`, offline) at the fix head.
- The cloud EE image check is green on cloud#3340 once its pin moves to a commit carrying the fix.

Dedup: objectstack issues for "authorable-surface base.json offline tag" return #14612 and #4563, both closed and about other failures.
